voice_events.translation_ja: こんにちは。素数を数えよう。

voice_events.text: A prime number is a whole number greater than one with exactly two positive factors: one and itself.
voice_events.spoken_text: A prime number is a whole number greater than one with exactly two positive factors: one and itself.

origin.correction_reason: Emphasize the conjunction and /ænd/ after one; preserve lexical transcript. Comma is an unspoken short prosodic boundary.

voice_events.phonemes: ɐ pɹˈaɪm nˈʌmbɚɹ ɪz ɐ hˈoʊl nˈʌmbɚ ɡɹˈeɪɾɚ ðɐn wˈʌn wɪð ɛɡzˈæktli tˈuː pˈɑːzᵻtˌɪv fˈæktɚz wˈʌn, ˈænd ɪtsˈɛlf
voice_events.correction_reason: Emphasize the conjunction and /ænd/ after one; preserve lexical transcript. Comma is an unspoken short prosodic boundary.
voice_events.baseline_phonemes: ɐ pɹˈaɪm nˈʌmbɚɹ ɪz ɐ hˈoʊl nˈʌmbɚ ɡɹˈeɪɾɚ ðɐn wˈʌn wɪð ɛɡzˈæktli tˈuː pˈɑːzᵻtˌɪv fˈæktɚz wˈʌn ænd ɪtsˈɛlf
voice_events.translation_ja: 素数は1より大きい整数で、約数が1とその数自身のちょうど二つだけある数だよ。

voice_events.text: A factor divides a number evenly, with nothing left over.
voice_events.spoken_text: A factor divides a number evenly, with nothing left over.
voice_events.translation_ja: 約数は、その数を余りなく割り切れる数だよ。
タイル5枚で試してみよう。

voice_events.text: Five makes one row of five. Its only factors are one and five.
voice_events.spoken_text: Five makes one row of five. Its only factors are one and five.
voice_events.translation_ja: 5枚は1行に5枚。約数は1と5だけだよ。

voice_events.text: Six also makes two rows of three. Six has more than two factors, so it is not prime.
voice_events.spoken_text: Six also makes two rows of three. Six has more than two factors, so it is not prime.
voice_events.translation_ja: 6枚は2行に3枚ずつも並べられるよ。約数が二つより多いから、素数ではないね。

voice_events.text: Turning a rectangle around does not give us new factors.
voice_events.spoken_text: Turning a rectangle around does not give us new factors.
voice_events.translation_ja: 長方形を回しても、新しい約数が増えるわけではないよ。

voice_events.text: One has only one factor: one. So one is not prime.
voice_events.spoken_text: One has only one factor: one. So one is not prime.
voice_events.translation_ja: 1の約数は1の一つだけ。だから1は素数ではないよ。

voice_events.text: Now let's count every prime number below one thousand.
voice_events.spoken_text: Now let's count every prime number below one thousand.
voice_events.translation_ja: では、1000未満のすべての素数を数えよう。

voice_events.text: Two has exactly two factors: one and two.
voice_events.spoken_text: Two has exactly two factors: one and two.
voice_events.translation_ja: 2の約数は1と2のちょうど二つ。

voice_events.text: Any larger even number has two as another factor.
voice_events.spoken_text: Any larger even number has two as another factor.
voice_events.translation_ja: 2より大きい偶数には、2という別の約数もあるね。

voice_events.text: Two is the only even prime.
voice_events.spoken_text: Two is the only even prime.
voice_events.translation_ja: 2は、ただ一つの偶数の素数だよ。

voice_events.text: Nine is odd, but three rows of three make nine.
voice_events.spoken_text: Nine is odd, but three rows of three make nine.
voice_events.translation_ja: 9は奇数だけれど、3行に3枚ずつで9枚になるね。

voice_events.text: Nine has factors other than one and itself. It is not prime.
voice_events.spoken_text: Nine has factors other than one and itself. It is not prime.

origin.correction_reason: Emphasize the conjunction and /ænd/ after one; preserve lexical transcript. Comma is an unspoken short prosodic boundary.

voice_events.phonemes: nˈaɪn hɐz fˈæktɚz ˈʌðɚ ðɐn wˈʌn, ˈænd ɪtsˈɛlf ɪɾ ɪz nˌɑːt pɹˈaɪm
voice_events.correction_reason: Emphasize the conjunction and /ænd/ after one; preserve lexical transcript. Comma is an unspoken short prosodic boundary.
voice_events.baseline_phonemes: nˈaɪn hɐz fˈæktɚz ˈʌðɚ ðɐn wˈʌn ænd ɪtsˈɛlf ɪɾ ɪz nˌɑːt pɹˈaɪm
voice_events.translation_ja: 9には1と9以外の約数があるよ。だから素数ではないね。

voice_events.text: Ninety-eight, ninety-nine, and one hundred have extra factors.
voice_events.spoken_text: Ninety-eight, ninety-nine, and one hundred have extra factors.
voice_events.translation_ja: 98、99、100には、1とその数自身以外にも約数があるね。

voice_events.text: The next prime after ninety-seven is one hundred one.
voice_events.spoken_text: The next prime after ninety-seven is one hundred one.
voice_events.translation_ja: 97の次の素数は101だよ。

voice_events.translation_ja: できたね。

voice_events.text: We counted all one hundred sixty-eight prime numbers below one thousand.
voice_events.spoken_text: We counted all one hundred sixty-eight prime numbers below one thousand.

origin.correction_reason: Explicitly stress We to clarify initial voiced glide.

voice_events.phonemes: wˈiː kˈaʊntᵻd ˈɔːl wˈʌn hˈʌndɹɪd sˈɪkstiˈeɪt pɹˈaɪm nˈʌmbɚz bᵻlˌoʊ wˈʌn θˈaʊzənd
voice_events.baseline_phonemes: wiː kˈaʊntᵻd ˈɔːl wˈʌn hˈʌndɹɪd sˈɪkstiˈeɪt pɹˈaɪm nˈʌmbɚz bᵻlˌoʊ wˈʌn θˈaʊzənd
voice_events.correction_reason: Explicitly stress We to clarify initial voiced glide.
voice_events.translation_ja: 1000未満の素数168個をすべて数えたね。

voice_events.text: The last one was nine hundred ninety-seven.
voice_events.spoken_text: The last one was nine hundred ninety-seven.
voice_events.translation_ja: 最後の数は997だったね。

voice_events.text: Thanks for counting with me. Bye for now!
voice_events.spoken_text: Thanks for counting with me. Bye for now!
voice_events.translation_ja: 一緒に数えてくれてありがとう。またね。
